It sharply separates nonlinear folds from exceptional points, gives an exact fabrication-detuning tolerance strip, the cusp onset amplitude and its strong-nonlinearity scaling. The source reports variable mode multiplicity graphically but no global classification; proving the exact boundary, not merely rewriting a polynomial, is a motivated finite-dimensional nonlinear spectral result.
